body:
Sam's Straws: 1. 10. 2. 2. 3. 5. 4. 25. 5. You count 10 at a time, so you say fewer numbers (10, 20, then 21, 22 ...).
Tens and Ones: 1. 3 tens and 4 ones. 2. 5 tens and 0 ones. 3. 17.
Draw It With Tens: 26 is 2 ten-sticks and 6 dots (2 tens and 6 ones). 41 is 4 ten-sticks and 1 dot (4 tens and 1 one).
Tens and Ones Check: 1. 4 tens and 7 ones. 2. 62. 3. 19. 4. 8 tens and 0 ones; 0 ones. 5. No. 13 is 1 ten and 3 ones; 3 tens and 1 one is 31.
Scoring tip: a student who draws 26 correctly but says "6 tens and 2 ones" is Got it! on drawing and Getting there on telling. On the check, accept a correct quick drawing as the explanation for problem 5.
title: Answer key: Tens and Ones
